title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3 sSRF was possible via custom plugin repositories (CVE-2026-123844)
description: A Server-Side Request Forgery (sSRF) vulnerability exists in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3. This vulnerability can be triggered via custom plugin repositories, potentially allowing an attacker to cause the application to make unauthorized requests. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3.
